question: Which of the following is the oldest atomic power plant of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tarapur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Tarapur Atomic Power Plant (TAPP) is the oldest nuclear power plant in India, established in 1969.
 
• It is located in Tarapur, Maharashtra, about 140 kilometers north of Mumbai.
 
• The plant was built with the help of the United States under the 1963 Indo-US nuclear cooperation agreement.
 
• Initially, the plant had two boiling water reactors (BWRs) with a capacity of 160 MW each, which were later upgraded.
 
• Tarapur Atomic Power Station is currently operated by the Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nuclear Power in India**

 
 
• India's nuclear power program aims to secure energy independence, utilizing its vast thorium reserves.
 
• The Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) oversees the country's nuclear energy production.
 
• As of 2023, India has 22 operational nuclear reactors in 7 nuclear power plants, with a total installed capacity of 6780 MW.
 
• Major nuclear power plants include Kudankulam, Kaiga, Kakrapar, Narora, and Rawatbhata.
 
 
 
• **Indo-US Nuclear Cooperation**
 
 
• The 1963 agreement led to the establishment of the Tarapur plant and laid the foundation for future nuclear cooperation.
 
• The Indo-US Civil Nuclear Agreement signed in 2008 further facilitated India's access to nuclear technology and fuel.
 
 
 
• **Boiling Water Reactor (BWR)**
 
 
• A BWR is a type of nuclear reactor that uses light water as both a coolant and a neutron moderator.
 
• In BWRs, water is boiled to produce steam directly in the reactor core, which then drives the turbine generator.
 
• Tarapur's initial reactors were BWRs, making it unique among India's nuclear reactors.
 
 
 
• **Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL)**
 
 
• NPCIL is a public sector enterprise under the DAE, responsible for designing, constructing, and operating nuclear power plants.
 
• It plays a crucial role in India's nuclear power generation and the implementation of advanced nuclear technologies.
